title: An Email From Maria
text:
Hi Anna, how are you? I am writing to you from Madrid. I am very happy here because my new job is good. My friends are nice, and we often eat dinner together.

Next weekend I want to visit you in London. Can you send me your address? Let me know if Sunday is good for you. Thanks, Maria

questions.text: What does Maria ask Anna to send her?
Why does Maria want to visit Anna?
options: She wants to see her friend.
She wants to find a new job.
She wants to move to Paris.
She wants to buy a house.

questions.text: How does Maria probably feel about her life in Madrid?

vocabulary.definition: putting words on paper or a screen to send to someone
the work a person does to earn money
the place where someone lives or receives letters
Saturday and Sunday, the days when many people do not work

paragraph_translations: Hola Anna, ¿cómo estás? Te escribo desde Madrid. Estoy muy contenta aquí porque mi nuevo trabajo es bueno. Mis amigos son simpáticos y a menudo cenamos juntos.
El próximo fin de semana quiero visitarte en Londres. ¿Puedes enviarme tu dirección? Dime si el domingo te viene bien. Gracias, Maria
